name: cruise
_comment: Track-level swing (0.3 ≈ a relaxed shuffle) grooves every part at once — the off-beat eighths of the melody and the arp's sixteenths all lay back. The three automation gestures are the point: a pad that SWELLS in (gain ramp), a lead filter that OPENS as the hook arrives (filter ramp), and an arp that DRIFTS across the stereo field (pan lfo).

sections.name: intro
sections._comment: Almost no groove yet — just the pad breathing in from silence (gain 0 -> 1) behind a closed-filter arp drifting left-to-right. The swell and the pan sweep are both automation, not static levels.

sections.name: groove
sections._comment: The pocket drops. Swing is loudest here — the shuffled hi-hats and the lead's off-beat eighths sit late. The lead enters on a slowly OPENING filter (500 -> 6500 Hz, exp) so the hook brightens as it climbs; the arp keeps drifting across the field; a gentle gain lilt breathes on the keys.

sections.name: outro
sections._comment: Ease out: only the head of the hook (slice [0,3]) over the pad, the lead filter closing again (6500 -> 900 Hz) and the whole thing fading on a gain ramp down — the swells and sweeps run in reverse to relax the cue home.
